title: Skull Bubble Storm
description: A surreal fantasy landscape depicts a winding path through a valley of pink and teal mountains under a dark, stormy sky with purple lightning. The foreground and midground are filled with large transparent bubbles containing red skulls, some dripping dark liquid, surrounded by vibrant autumn-colored foliage and lily pads on the water.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape with a winding path leading toward distant pink mountains under a dark stormy sky filled with swirling teal clouds and bright purple lightning. The scene is populated with numerous transparent floating bubbles containing red skulls that drip dark liquid, set among vibrant pink, orange, and teal autumn leaves and lily pads on reflective water pools.
